description: Use this when you need a player_id or team_id, or the user names a player or team you have not resolved yet ('Jokic', 'Lamar Jackson', 'BOS'); it is accent- and typo-tolerant. Returns up to six matching players and four teams per league with their numeric ids (`players_more` and the like say there are more: narrow the query); each list's page is a template such as `player_url` with the id in place of {id}. Not for stats: call player_profile or team_profile with the id.

league.description: Optional league filter ("nba" or "nfl"). Omit to search both leagues.

query.description: Player or team name or abbreviation (e.g. "Jokic", "Lamar Jackson", "BOS").

name: search
title: Search Players & Teams
